paragraphs: As used herein, unless we otherwise specify, the terms "we," "us," "our," "Nathan's," "Nathan's Famous" and the "Company" mean Nathan's Famous, Inc. and its subsidiaries. References to a year are to our fiscal year, unless the context requires otherwise. Our 2026 year commenced on March 31, 2025 and ended on March 29, 2026; and our 2025 year commenced on April 1, 2024 and ended on March 30, 2025.

We are a leading branded licensor, wholesaler and retailer of products marketed under our Nathan's Famous brand, including our popular Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs. What began as a nickel hot dog stand on Coney Island in 1916 has evolved into a highly recognized brand throughout the United States and the world. Our innovative business model seeks to maximize the points of distribution for and the consumption of Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs, crinkle-cut French fries and our other products across a wide-range of grocery retail and foodservice formats. Our products are currently marketed for sale in thousands of locations, including supermarkets, mass merchandisers and club stores, selected foodservice locations and our Company-owned and franchised restaurants throughout the United States and in twenty foreign countries. The Company considers itself to be in the foodservice industry and has pursued co-branding initiatives within other foodservice environments. Our major channels of distribution are as follows:

Our licensing program contracts with certain third parties to manufacture, distribute, market and sell a broad variety of Nathan's Famous branded products including our hot dogs, frozen crinkle-cut French fries and additional products through supermarkets, grocery channels and club stores throughout the United States. As of March 29, 2026, packaged Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs continued to be sold in supermarkets, mass merchandisers and club stores including Walmart, Kroger, Ahold, Publix, Albertsons, Safeway, ShopRite, Target, Costco and BJ's Wholesale Club located in all 50 states. We earn revenue through royalties on products sold by our licensees.

Our Branded Product Program provides foodservice operators in a variety of venues the opportunity to capitalize on our Nathan's Famous brand by marketing and selling certain Nathan's Famous hot dog and specialty products. We believe that the program has broad appeal to foodservice operators due to its flexibility to deliver our products to a wide variety of distribution channels. In conjunction with the program, foodservice operators are granted a limited use of the Nathan's Famous trademark, as well as Nathan's Famous point of purchase materials. Unlike our licensing and franchise programs, we do not generate revenue from royalties, but rather by selling our hot dog products either directly to foodservice operators or to various foodservice distributors who resell the products to foodservice accounts.

Operating quick-service restaurants featuring Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs, crinkle-cut French fries, and a variety of other menu offerings, which operate under the name "Nathan's Famous," the name first used at our original Coney Island restaurant which opened in 1916.

Our franchised restaurant operations predominately feature a menu consisting of Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs, crinkle-cut French fries and beverages as well as other items. We earn royalties on sales at these franchise locations and virtual kitchens (existing kitchens with no Nathan's Famous branded storefront presence, used to fill online orders for delivery). In addition to our traditional franchised restaurants and virtual kitchens, we enable approved foodservice operators to offer a Nathan's Famous menu of Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs, crinkle-cut French fries, proprietary toppings and a limited menu of other Nathan's products through our Branded Menu Program ("BMP"). We earn royalties on Nathan's products purchased from Nathan's approved distributors by our BMP franchise operators.

We also own the Arthur Treacher's Fish & Chips brand and trademarks. We use the Arthur Treacher's Fish & Chips brand, products and trademarks as a branded seafood menu-line extension for inclusion in certain Nathan's Famous restaurants, as well as online platforms for third party delivery, such as UberEats, GrubHub and DoorDash.

On January 20, 2026, the Company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement") with Smithfield Foods, Inc., a Virginia corporation ("Buyer" or "Smithfield Foods") and Boardwalk Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of Buyer ("Merger Sub"). Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, and upon the terms and subject to the conditions thereof and in accordance with the General Corporation Law of the State of Delaware, Merger Sub shall merge with and into the Company (the "Merger," and the effective time of the Merger, the "Effective Time"). As a result of the Merger, at the Effective Time, the separate corporate existence of Merger Sub shall cease, the Company shall continue as the surviving corporation in the Merger (the "Surviving Corporation") and the Surviving Corporation shall become a wholly owned subsidiary of Buyer. After the Merger, the Company shall cease to be publicly traded. Completion of the transaction remains contingent upon meeting several conditions specified in the Merger Agreement. These include securing approval from the holders of a majority of Nathan's outstanding stock, obtaining clearance from the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS), and fulfilling other closing requirements. However, given the impact of the partial government shutdown on statutory deadlines for CFIUS's review process, our anticipated closing timeline has shifted, and we now expect the transaction to close in the second half of 2026. See NOTE N – MERGER to the accompanying Consolidated Financial Statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
We believe that we benefit from the following competitive strengths:

For over 100 years, we have cultivated Nathan's Famous into an iconic brand with global recognition. From our authentic origins on Coney Island to our popular Nathan's Famous International Hot Dog Eating Contest, the Nathan's Famous brand has become synonymous with premium hot dogs enjoyed throughout the year including cookouts, and July 4th celebrations. Over time, we have continued expanding the number and types of points of distribution for Nathan's Famous products by leveraging our highly recognizable brand.

Since our beginnings as a nickel hot dog stand in 1916, we have focused on creating the best premium hot dog. Using premium cuts of meat, our proprietary spice mix and based on a recipe originally developed in 1916, our hot dogs have a unique flavor and texture that consumers are drawn to.
Our hot dogs have received numerous awards and recognition from critics and reviewers.

Recognition as an award-winning hot dog has strengthened our brand and created a devoted fan base. We believe that our high brand awareness allows us to sell hot dogs at a premium price compared to competing brands across all channels of distribution.

We believe that our flexible business model enables us to diversify across multiple channels of distribution and customers. Our products are distributed through supermarkets, mass merchandisers, club stores, Company-owned restaurants, franchised restaurants, virtual kitchens, food service distributors and other food service operators such as gas stations, movie theaters, amusement parks and sporting venues. We believe that there is potential to increase our sales by converting sales of non-branded products throughout the foodservice industry.

headings: Risks Related to the Merger with Smithfield Foods
The announcement and pendency of the proposed Merger with Smithfield Foods may adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Failure to complete the Merger could negatively impact the price of our common stock, as well as our future business and financial results.
Expenses related to the pending Merger are significant and will adversely affect our operating results.
We are subject to business uncertainties and contractual restrictions while the Merger is pending, which could adversely affect our business.
Litigation could result in substantial costs and may delay or prevent the Merger from being completed.
Risks Related to Our Business and Operations
Our results of operations could be adversely affected by pandemics, disease epidemics, or other public health concerns.
Our results of operations could be adversely affected by increases in the cost of food, commodities and paper.
Price increases may impact customer visits.
A significant amount of our Branded Product Program revenue is from a small number of accounts. The loss of any one or more of those accounts could harm our profitability and operating results.

Smithfield Foods currently has two manufacturing facilities producing different Nathan's products and a long-term significant interruption of a primary facility could potentially disrupt our operations.
The loss of one or more of our key suppliers could lead to supply disruptions, increased costs and lower operating results.
The quick-service restaurant business is highly competitive, and that competition could lower revenues, margins and market share.
Changes in economic, market and other conditions could adversely affect us and our franchisees, and thereby our operating results.
Current restaurant locations may become unattractive, and attractive new locations may not be available for a reasonable price, if at all, which may reduce our revenue.
Any perceived or real health risks related to the food industry could adversely affect our ability to sell our products.
We may not be able to adequately protect our intellectual property, which could decrease the value of our business or the value of our brands and products.
The sophistication and buying power of our customers could have a negative impact on profits.

Our annual and quarterly financial results may fluctuate depending on various factors, many of which are beyond our control, and, if we fail to meet the expectations of investors, our share price may decline.
Our operations are influenced by adverse weather conditions.
Climate change could adversely affect our results of operation and financial condition.
Cyberattacks and breaches could cause operational disruptions, fraud or theft of sensitive information.
Our international operations are subject to various factors of uncertainty.
Our business operations and future development could be significantly disrupted if we lose key personnel.
Risks Related to Regulatory Matters
Changes to minimum wage rates have increased our labor costs.

Changes in franchise regulations and laws could impact our ability to obtain or retain licenses or approvals and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects.

Failure by third-party manufacturers or suppliers of raw materials to comply with food safety, environmental or other regulations may disrupt our supply of certain products and adversely affect our business.
paragraphs: Our business is subject to various risks. Certain risks are specific to certain ways we do business, such as through Company-owned restaurants, franchised restaurants, virtual kitchens, branded products and retail, while other risks, such as health-related or economic risks, may affect all of the ways that we do business.

Investors should carefully consider all of the information set forth in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the following risk factors, before deciding to invest in any of the Company's securities. The following risk factors are not exhaustive. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to the Company may also adversely impact its business. The Company's business, financial condition, results of operations or prospects could be adversely affected by any of these risks. In that case, the trading price of the Company's common stock could decline. This Form 10-K also contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. The Company's results could materially differ from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of certain factors, including the risks it faces described below and elsewhere. See "Forward-Looking Statements" above.

There are material uncertainties and risks associated with the proposed Merger, including the timing of the consummation of the Merger, which may adversely affect our business and ongoing operations, financial condition and results of operations, employees, customers, stockholders, other parties and business prospects and a failure to complete the Merger on the terms reflected in the Merger Agreement or at all could have a material and adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, and stock price. Refer to NOTE A – DESCRIPTION AND ORGANIZATION OF THE BUSINESS to our Consolidated Financial Statements in Item 1 of Part I of this Report, for further information.

The Merger Agreement contains a number of conditions that must be satisfied or waived prior to the completion of the Merger, including stockholder approval and regulatory approval. We cannot assure you that all of the conditions to the Merger will be satisfied or waived on a timely basis. If the conditions to the Merger are not satisfied or waived on a timely basis, we may be unable to complete the Merger as quickly as expected or at all.

If the Merger is not completed, our ongoing business may be adversely affected as follows: (i) we may experience negative reactions from the financial markets, including negative impacts on the market price of our common stock; (ii) some of management's attention will have been directed to the Merger instead of being directed to our own operations and the pursuit of other opportunities that could have been beneficial to us; (iii) the manner in which customers, suppliers and other third parties perceive us may be negatively impacted, which in turn could have an adverse effect on our business; (iv) we may experience negative reactions from employees; (v) we will have expended time and resources that could otherwise have been spent on our business; and (vi) we may be required, in certain circumstances, to pay a termination fee of $10,581,814, as provided in the Merger Agreement. In addition, any significant delay in consummating the Merger could have an adverse effect on our operating results and adversely affect our relationships with customers and suppliers and would likely lead to a significant diversion of management and employee attention.

If the Merger is not completed, neither we nor the holders of our common stock will realize these benefits of the Merger. Moreover, we would also have nevertheless incurred substantial transaction-related fees and costs and the loss of management time and resources.

paragraphs: We are engaged primarily in the marketing of the "Nathan's Famous" brand and the sale of products bearing the "Nathan's Famous" trademarks through several different channels of distribution. Historically, our business has been the operation and franchising of quick-service restaurants featuring Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs, crinkle-cut French fries, and a variety of other menu offerings. Our Company-owned and franchised restaurants operate under the name "Nathan's Famous," the name first used at our original Coney Island restaurant opened in 1916. Nathan's product licensing program sells packaged hot dogs, frozen crinkle-cut French fries and additional products to retail customers through supermarkets, grocery channels and club stores for off-site consumption. Our Branded Product Program enables foodservice retailers and others to sell some of Nathan's proprietary products outside of the realm of a traditional franchise relationship. In conjunction with this program, purchasers of Nathan's products are granted a limited use of the Nathan's Famous trademark with respect to the sale of the purchased products, including Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs, certain other proprietary food items and paper goods. Our Branded Menu Program is a limited franchise program, under which foodservice operators may sell a greater variety of Nathan's Famous menu items than under the Branded Product Program.

Our revenues are generated primarily from selling products under Nathan's Branded Product Program, operating Company-owned restaurants, licensing agreements for the sale of Nathan's products within supermarkets, grocery stores and club stores, the manufacture of certain proprietary spices by third parties and the royalties, fees and other sums we can earn from franchising the Nathan's restaurant concept (including the Branded Menu Program and virtual kitchens).

At March 29, 2026, our franchise system consisted of 221 Nathan's franchised locations, including 110 Branded Menu locations located in 19 states, and 11 foreign countries. We also operate four Company-owned restaurants (including one seasonal unit), within the New York metropolitan area.

Our primary focus is to expand the market penetration of the Nathan's Famous brand by increasing the number of distribution points for our products across all of our business platforms, including our Licensing Program for distribution of Nathan's Famous branded consumer packaged goods, our Branded Products Program for distribution of Nathan's Famous branded bulk products to the foodservice industry, and our namesake restaurant system comprised of both Company-owned and franchised restaurants, including virtual kitchens. The primary drivers of our growth have been our Licensing and Branded Product Programs, which are the largest contributors to the Company's revenues and profits.

While we do not expect to significantly increase the number of Company-owned restaurants, we may opportunistically and strategically invest in a small number of new units as showcase locations for prospective franchisees and master developers as we seek to grow our franchise system. We continue to seek opportunities to drive sales in a variety of ways as we adapt to the ever-changing consumer and business climate.

As described in Item 1A. "Risk Factors" and other sections in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended March 29, 2026, our future results could be impacted by many developments including the impact of the inflationary pressures on our business, as well as the pendency of the proposed merger with Smithfield Foods.

paragraphs: 如本文所用，除非我們另有說明，"we," "us," "our," "Nathan's," "Nathan's Famous" 以及 "the Company" 皆指 Nathan's Famous, Inc. 及其子公司。提及年份時，除非上下文另有要求，否則皆指本公司會計年度。本公司 2026 年度自 2025 年 3 月 31 日起，至 2026 年 3 月 29 日止；本公司 2025 年度自 2024 年 4 月 1 日起，至 2025 年 3 月 30 日止。

本公司為美國及全球知名的 Nathan's Famous 品牌產品之領導品牌授權、經銷與零售商，包括我們熱門的 Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs。自 1916 年在 Coney Island 開設五毛錢熱狗攤開始，已發展成為美國與全球高度認知的品牌。我們創新之商業模式旨在最大化 Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs、crinkle-cut French fries 及其他產品在廣泛零售與餐飲格式中的銷售點與消費量。我們產品目前在數千個銷售點販售，包括超級市場、量販店與俱樂部商店、選定餐飲場所，以及本公司自有與加盟之餐廳，遍及美國與二十個外國國家。本公司自認為屬於餐飲產業，並在其他餐飲環境中進行共品牌計畫。我們主要之銷售通路如下：

我們之授權計畫與特定第三方簽訂契約，製造、經銷、行銷與銷售廣泛之 Nathan's Famous 品牌產品，包括熱狗、速凍 crinkle-cut French fries 及其他產品，透過美國各地之超級市場、零售通路與俱樂部商店銷售。截至 2026 年 3 月 29 日，包裝好的 Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs 仍持續在超級市場、量販店與俱樂部商店銷售，包括 Walmart、Kroger、Ahold、Publix、Albertsons、Safeway、ShopRite、Target、Costco 及 BJ's Wholesale Club，位於美國所有 50 個州。我們透過授權經銷商銷售產品所產生之 royalty 獲得收入。

我們之品牌產品計畫為不同場所之餐飲經營者提供機會，利用我們 Nathan's Famous 品牌行銷與銷售特定 Nathan's Famous 熱狗與特製產品。我們認為此計畫因靈活度高，可將產品送達廣泛之銷售通路，而對餐飲經營者具有廣泛吸引力。配合此計畫，餐飲經營者可有限使用 Nathan's Famous 商標，以及 Nathan's Famous 終端展示資料。與我們授權與加盟計畫不同，我們並非透過 royalty 獲得收入，而是透過直接向餐飲經營者銷售熱狗產品，或向各餐飲經銷商銷售，由經銷商再轉售至餐飲客戶。
經營以 Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs、crinkle-cut French fries 及多樣其他餐點為特色的快速服務餐廳，並以 "Nathan's Famous" 為名稱營運，此為我們原 Coney Island 餐廳所使用的名稱，該餐廳於 1916 年開設。

我們之加盟餐廳營運主要以 Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs、crinkle-cut French fries 及飲料，以及其他項目為餐點內容。我們透過這些加盟點銷售所得收取 royalty，以及虛擬廚房（無 Nathan's Famous 品牌門店的現有廚房，用於處理線上訂單以供外送）。除了傳統加盟餐廳與虛擬廚房外，我們亦允許經批准之餐飲經營者透過我們之品牌餐點計畫（"BMP"）提供 Nathan's Famous 餐點，包括 Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs、crinkle-cut French fries、專利配料及有限其他 Nathan's 產品。我們透過 BMP 加盟經營者從 Nathan's 認可經銷商處購入 Nathan's 產品所產生之 royalty 獲得收入。
我們亦擁有 Arthur Treacher's Fish & Chips 品牌與商標。我們使用 Arthur Treacher's Fish & Chips 品牌、產品與商標，作為品牌海鮮餐點延伸，包含於部分 Nathan's Famous 餐廳，以及線上平台供第三方外送，如 UberEats、GrubHub 及 DoorDash。

2026 年 1 月 20 日，本公司與 Smithfield Foods, Inc.（位於維吉尼亞州之公司，"Buyer" 或 "Smithfield Foods"）及 Boardwalk Merger Sub, Inc.（位於特拉華州之公司，為 Buyer 之 wholly owned 子公司，"Merger Sub"）簽訂合併協議（"Merger Agreement"）。根據 Merger Agreement，並於其條款與條件下，並依照特拉華州公司法，Merger Sub 將與本公司合併（"Merger"，合併生效時間為 "Effective Time"）。根據合併，於 Effective Time 時，Merger Sub 之獨立法人地位將終止，本公司將成為合併後之存續公司（"Surviving Corporation"），並成為 Buyer 之 wholly owned 子公司。合併後，本公司將不再公開交易。交易完成仍需符合 Merger Agreement 所規定之條件。這些條件包括取得 Nathan's 股東過半數同意、獲得美國對外投資委員會（CFIUS）審查批准，以及達成其他關閉條件。然而，因部分政府停擺對 CFIUS 審查程序法定期限的影響，我們預期的交易完成時間已延後，預計於 2026 年第二季完成交易。請參閱 NOTE N – MERGER 有關本公司財務報表之合併財務資料，包含於本年度 10-K 報告之其他部分。
我們認為我們擁有以下競爭優勢：

在超過 100 年的時間裡，我們已將 Nathan's Famous 培育成為一個具有全球認知度的標誌性品牌。從我們在 Coney Island 的真實起源，到我們廣為人知的 Nathan's Famous International Hot Dog Eating Contest，Nathan's Famous 品牌已成為全年享受的高級熱狗的代名詞，包括野餐以及 7 月 4 日慶典。隨時間的推移，我們持續擴展 Nathan's Famous 產品的銷售點數量與類型，透過我們高度認知的品牌來實現。
自 1916 年我們作為一個五美分熱狗攤開始以來，我們一直專注於創造最佳的高級熱狗。使用高級肉類切塊、我們專利的香料混合配方，並基於 1916 年最初開發的食譜，我們的熱狗擁有獨特的風味與口感，吸引消費者。
我們的熱狗已獲得許多評論家與評測者的獎項與認可。
作為獲獎熱狗的認可，已加強我們的品牌並創造了一羣忠實的粉絲。我們認為，我們高程度的品牌認知度使我們能夠在所有銷售通路中，以較競爭品牌更高的價格銷售熱狗。
我們認為我們靈活的商業模式使我們能夠跨多個銷售通路與客戶進行多元化。我們的產品透過超市、量販店、俱樂部商店、本公司-owned 餐廳、特許經營餐廳、虛擬廚房、餐飲分銷商及其他餐飲業者如加油站、電影院、主題公園與體育場地進行銷售。我們認為，有潛力透過將餐飲業中非品牌產品的銷售轉換為品牌產品來增加我們的銷售額。

paragraphs: 本公司主要從事「Nathan's Famous」品牌的行銷，以及透過多種通路銷售標有「Nathan's Famous」商標的產品。歷來，本公司業務為經營與特許經營快速服務餐廳，提供Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs、crinkle-cut French fries以及多種其他餐點。本公司自有與特許經營的餐廳均以「Nathan's Famous」為名稱，此為本公司於1916年開設原Coney Island餐廳時所使用的名稱。Nathan's產品授權計劃透過超級市場、雜貨通路及俱樂部商店，向零售客戶銷售包裝熱狗、冷凍crinkle-cut French fries及其他產品，供離場食用。本公司Branded Product Program使食品服務零售商及其他業者得以在非傳統特許經營關係下銷售部分Nathan's專屬產品。配合此計劃，購買Nathan's產品的買方可有限使用Nathan's Famous商標，用以銷售所購產品，包括Nathan's World Famous Beef Hot Dogs、某些其他專屬食品及紙製商品。本公司Branded Menu Program為一有限特許經營計劃，使食品服務業者可銷售較Branded Product Program下更廣的Nathan's Famous餐點項目。
本公司營業收入主要來自銷售Nathan's Branded Product Program下的產品、經營自有餐廳、在超級市場、雜貨店及俱樂部商店銷售Nathan's產品的授權協議、由第三方製造某些專屬香料，以及透過特許經營Nathan's餐廳概念（包括Branded Menu Program及虛擬廚房）所賺取的特許權費、費用及其他金額。
以下摘要反映截至2026年3月29日及2025年3月30日財務年度結束時，Nathan's特許經營系統（包括Branded Menu Program）的開店與關店數量。
2026年3月29日 2025年3月30日 開始餘額 開店 關店 (32 (25 結束餘額 (a) (a)
依循本公司Branded Product Program及虛擬廚房運作的單位不計在內。
截至2026年3月29日，本公司特許經營系統包含221家Nathan's特許經營據點，其中110家為Branded Menu據點，分佈於19個州及11個外國。本公司亦在紐約都會區經營四家自有餐廳（含一家季節性據點）。

本公司主要目標為透過增加產品在各業務平台的通路點，來擴大Nathan's Famous品牌的市場佔有率，包括Nathan's Famous品牌消費者包裝商品的授權計劃、Nathan's Famous品牌大宗產品對食品服務業的分銷計劃，以及本公司名稱的餐廳系統，包含自有與特許經營的餐廳，包括虛擬廚房。本公司成長的主要驅動力為授權與Branded Product Programs，這兩個計劃為本公司營收與獲利的最大貢獻者。
雖然本公司不預期大幅增加自有餐廳數量，但可能在適當且戰略性的機會下，投資少量新據點作為潛在特許經營商與總開發商的展示據點，以促進本公司特許經營系統的成長。本公司持續尋找各種方式來推動銷售，以適應不斷變化的消費者與商業環境。

headings: 與 Smithfield Foods 合併相關的風險
與合併 Smithfield Foods 的公告及待決狀態有關，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生不利影響。
未能完成合併可能會對我們的普通股價格以及未來的業務與財務結果產生負面影響。
與待決合併相關的費用相當重大，將對我們的營運結果產生不利影響。
在合併待決期間，我們面臨業務不確定性及契約限制，這可能會對我們的業務產生不利影響。
訴訟可能會導致重大成本，並可能延誤或阻止合併的完成。
與我們的業務及營運相關的風險
我們的營運結果可能因疫情、疾病爆發或其他公共衛生問題而受到不利影響。
本公司營運成果可能因食品、原物料及紙張成本增加而受到不利影響。
價格上漲可能影響顧客造訪人數。
本公司品牌產品計劃的收入來自少數幾個帳戶，若失去其中一個或數個帳戶，可能影響本公司利潤及營運成果。
Smithfield Foods 目前擁有兩座製造廠生產不同 Nathan's 產品，若主要製造廠發生長期重大中斷，可能影響本公司營運。
失去一個或數個關鍵供應商可能導致供應中斷、成本增加及營運成果下降。
速食餐廳業為高度競爭產業，此競爭可能降低收入、毛利率及市佔率。
經濟、市場及其他條件的變動可能對本公司及其加盟者造成不利影響，進而影響本公司營運成果。
現有餐廳門點可能變得不具吸引力，且具吸引力的新門點可能無法以合理價格取得，甚至無法取得，這可能降低本公司收入。
任何被認為或實際存在的食品產業健康風險，可能會不利於我們銷售產品的能力。
我們可能無法充分保護我們的智慧財產權，這可能會降低我們業務或品牌與產品的價值。
我們客戶的專業程度與購買力可能會對利潤產生負面影響。
我們的年度與季度財務結果可能根據多種因素而波動，其中許多因素超出我們的控制範圍，若我們未能符合投資人的期待，股價可能會下跌。
我們的營運受到不利天氣條件的影響。
氣候變遷可能會對我們的營運結果與財務狀況產生不利影響。
網路攻擊與資料外洩可能會導致營運中斷、詐欺或敏感資訊的竊取。
我們的國際營運受到多種不確定因素的影響。
本公司營運及未來發展若失去關鍵人員，可能造成重大幹擾。
與法規事項相關之風險
最低工資率變動已提高本公司勞動成本。
加盟制度相關法規與法律之變更，可能影響本公司取得或維持許可證或核准之能力，並對本公司營運、財務狀況、營業成果與前景造成不利影響。
第三方製造商或原材料供應商未能遵守食品安全、環境或其他法規，可能幹擾本公司部分產品之供應，並對本公司營運造成不利影響。
paragraphs: 本公司業務面臨各種風險。某些風險與本公司特定的營運方式有關，例如透過本公司自營餐廳、特許經營餐廳、虛擬廚房、品牌產品及零售業務，而其他風險，例如與健康或經濟相關的風險，可能影響所有營運方式。

投資人應在決定投資本公司證券前，仔細考慮本年度報告表10-K中所列的所有資訊，包括下列風險因素。下列風險因素並非完整清單。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前本公司尚未知悉，也可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果或前景可能因任何這些風險而受到不利影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能下跌。本表10-K亦包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。本公司結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述中預期的結果有重大差異，原因包括本公司所面臨的風險，如下列所述及其它處所提及的風險。請參閱上方的「前瞻性陳述」。

與擬議合併有關的重大不確定性與風險，包括合併完成的時間，可能對本公司業務與持續營運、財務狀況與營運結果、員工、客戶、股東、其他相關方與業務前景造成不利影響。若未能依照合併協議所載條件完成合併，或完全無法完成合併，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流與股票價格造成重大且不利的影響。請參閱本報告第一部分第一項「財務會計資訊」中「財務報表之業務描述與組織」（NOTE A – DESCRIPTION AND ORGANIZATION OF THE BUSINESS）以取得更多資訊。
合併協議包含若干必須達成或經豁免的條件，方能完成合併，包括股東批准與監管機構批准。本公司無法保證所有合併條件將在合理時間內達成或經豁免。若合併條件未能在合理時間內達成或經豁免，本公司可能無法如期完成合併，或完全無法完成合併。

若合併未能完成，本公司持續營運可能受到以下不利影響：(i) 本公司可能面臨財務市場的負面反應，包括對本公司普通股市場價格的負面影響；(ii) 部分管理層的注意力將轉向合併，而非專注於本公司營運與追求其他可能對本公司有益的機會；(iii) 客戶、供應商及其他第三方對本公司的看法可能受到負面影響，進而對本公司業務造成不利影響；(iv) 本公司可能面臨員工的負面反應；(v) 本公司可能已耗費原本可用於業務的時間與資源；(vi) 在某些情況下，本公司可能需支付終止費用，金額為10,581,814美元，如合併協議所載。此外，任何重大延誤完成合併，可能對本公司營運結果造成不利影響，並對與客戶與供應商的關係造成不利影響，且很可能導致管理層與員工的注意力大幅分散。
若合併未能完成，本公司與本公司普通股持有人將無法實現合併的這些好處。此外，本公司仍將承擔重大交易相關費用與成本，以及管理層時間與資源的損失。
